patch.value: GH-975: export isAlreadyClaimedError through a supported SDK subpath

Track GitHub issue #975: the shipped claim typings declare the sanctioned lost-race predicate, but no package export exposes it, forcing extensions to hard-code the internal already_claimed_by error code.

Export isAlreadyClaimedError from the canonical SDK lifecycle surface; packed ESM and TypeScript consumers can import it; public-surface and package-boundary gates cover the export; no extension must duplicate the internal code predicate
Import sdk, sdk/core, and sdk/runtime from the packed package and inspect isAlreadyClaimedError; direct sdk/lifecycle/claim import is rejected by package exports.
The documented predicate is reachable from a supported SDK subpath beside claim/release, with runtime/type/public-surface parity.
The declaration ships but every supported subpath returns undefined and the implementation module is not exported.
Extension concurrency guards couple to an internal error code and may fail open after an error-code rename.
